 The Bruins and Hurricanes will face off on Tuesday night in what could be a preview of a playoff matchup.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Boston has won seven of its last eight games, scoring 12 total goals in back-to-back victories last week. James Hagens has made an early impact in his rookie season with nine points (four goals, five assists) in 12 games.
 The Hurricanes are 2-2 in their last four games. Sebastian Aho leads Carolina with 18 points (seven goals, 11 assists).
 NESN will provide live coverage of the game between the Bruins and Hurricanes.
